text: Why choosing this program? The university’s discipline of architecture takes the leading position home and abroad and keeps an increasing influence in the world. The graduates, including some prominent members of the Academy of Engineering of China and many noted experts, have contributed a lot to the development of architecture.Main Courses Fundamentals of Architectural Design, The Principle of Architecture Design, History of Chinese and Foreign Architecuture, Building Structure and Architectural Mechanics, Building Construction etc.Internship Graduates will have many practical teaching, including art practice, site practice, construction practice of surveying and mapping, practice of knowing architecture, design institute production practice. After this program study, students can work as a designer in design departments and become advanced engineering technicians. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Architecture by Ningbo University
